source_trace.meaning: Entry point 9/17 selects ONE+ONE; material 9821 returns from entry 9 with 0x01010101.
After material binding, tests post+108 bit 1 and calls sub_8217FDA0(1) at 0x8218478C.
When enabled and global 0x828E6889 is zero, sets engine cached mode 0 and calls sub_82178C10(device,0) at 0x8217FDF4, then enables alpha testing.
Called from 0x82184F28: serializes the recorded device state into type-0 packets. Exact packet address and full packet bytes uniquely match the GPU witness for each bad draw.

diagnostic_validation.command_fixture: PASS: wrapped packets, nested scope restoration, exact history; bytes and read/write cursors unchanged
diagnostic_validation.bounds: Native trace: 15 seconds/100000 records (28.8 MB); GPU trace retains 300 frames/15 seconds/512 MiB. Each private game terminated at 180 seconds.

next_step: Audit suitable native alpha-cutout shader paths; preserve cutout coverage while keeping additive dynamic lighting. The stock LOD donor also has post flag 2, so changing a shared template or clearing the flag without preserving alpha testing is not justified.
limitations: No rendering fix or release promotion yet.
This identifies the repeatable private fabric event, not every reported surface or the original human bad frame.
The saved pose is exact but is not a complete simulation savestate.
Searchlight, billboard visual acceptance, traversal/performance and physical Xbox/system-link acceptance remain incomplete.
